requested.title: What If AI Rented Your Brain While You Slept?
requested.description:
A thin band on your forehead. While you sleep, a company rents your brain, and every morning it pays you by the hour. Night one pays ninety dollars. What's the catch?

So, would you rent your nights? Tell us in the comments. The best what-ifs become videos.

Chapters
0:00 The Chair
1:21 The Rule
2:27 Crumbs
4:26 More Hours
6:12 The Night Shift
8:05 The Warehouses
9:30 The Contract
10:10 One Mind

The band is made up. The facts are real:
- The US lets companies pay people for their blood plasma: ProPublica (2019)
  https://www.propublica.org/article/pharmaceutical-companies-are-luring-mexicans-across-the-u.s.-border-to-donate-blood-plasma
- US rules allow plasma twice in any seven days, at least two days apart: 21 CFR 640.65
  https://www.ecfr.gov/current/title-21/chapter-I/subchapter-F/part-640/subpart-G/section-640.65
- About two thirds of the world's plasma comes from the US: NPR Planet Money (2021)
  https://www.npr.org/2021/05/21/999241523/another-shortage-caused-by-the-pandemic-blood-plasma
- People cross into El Paso to sell plasma, some twice a week, where a typical worker across the river made about $9 a day (2019): ProPublica
  https://www.propublica.org/article/pharmaceutical-companies-are-luring-mexicans-across-the-u.s.-border-to-donate-blood-plasma
- The brain is about 2% of body weight and uses about 20% of its energy, about 20 watts: Raichle and Gusnard, PNAS (2002); NIST
  https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC124895/
- We spend about a third of our lives asleep: NIH NINDS
  https://www.ninds.nih.gov/health-information/public-education/brain-basics/brain-basics-understanding-sleep
- In mice, the space between brain cells grows about 60% in sleep and waste is washed out faster: Xie et al., Science (2013)
  https://europepmc.org/article/MED/24136970
- In animals, the brain replays the day's activity in sleep, faster than real time: Rasch and Born, Physiological Reviews (2013)
  https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC3768102/
- Mechanical Turk (2005) paid a few cents a task and was named after an 18th-century chess "robot" with a hidden human: CNBC (2026)
  https://www.cnbc.com/2026/08/25/amazon-service-that-jeff-bezos-called-artificial-ai-is-shutting-down.html
- In 2020, over a million volunteers' computers formed what Folding@home's scientists called the first exascale computer: Zimmerman et al., Nature Chemistry (2021)
  https://europepmc.org/article/MED/34031561
- Otto Loewi's Nobel Prize experiment came to him in a dream: McCoy and Tan, Singapore Medical Journal (2014)
  https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC4291908/
- More than a third of American adults don't get enough sleep: CDC (2016)
  https://archive.cdc.gov/www_cdc_gov/media/releases/2016/p0215-enough-sleep.html

Narrated with an AI voice. Music made with AI. Animated in code.
